# cosmo_organization_group (Resource)

Manages an organization group (a set of role-based permissions) in Cosmo. Members and API keys are assigned to a group to receive its permissions.

Requires the RBAC feature to be enabled for the organization, and an API key with the `organization-admin` role.

For more information on groups, please refer to the [Cosmo Documentation](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/studio/groups).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmo_namespace" "team" {
  name = var.namespace
}

# A group whose members can view the whole organization and administer one namespace.
resource "cosmo_organization_group" "team" {
  name        = var.name
  description = "Platform team"

  rules = [
    { role = "organization-viewer" },
    { role = "namespace-admin", namespaces = [cosmo_namespace.team.id] },
  ]

  # Needed only if people or API keys outside Terraform are still in the group when it is destroyed.
  # move_members_to_group_id = data.cosmo_organization_group.viewer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group. Groups cannot be renamed, so changing this recreates the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the group.
- `move_members_to_group_id` (String) Only used when the group is destroyed: the ID of the group to move this group's members, API keys and OIDC mappers to. The control plane refuses to delete a group that still has any of these unless this is set.
- `rules` (Attributes Set) The roles granted by the group. Use at most one rule per role. Omit to create a group with no permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `role` (String) The role to grant. One of: `organization-admin`, `organization-developer`, `organization-viewer`, `organization-apikey-manager`, `namespace-admin`, `namespace-viewer`, `graph-admin`, `graph-viewer`, `subgraph-admin`, `subgraph-publisher`, `subgraph-checker`, `subgraph-viewer`.

Optional:

- `namespaces` (Set of String) Namespace IDs (for example `cosmo_namespace.example.id`) the role is limited to. Omit to grant the role on all namespaces. Not allowed for the `organization-*` admin, developer and viewer roles, or together with `resources`.
- `resources` (Set of String) Target IDs of the federated graphs or subgraphs the role is limited to. Omit to grant the role on all resources. Not allowed for the `organization-*` admin, developer and viewer roles, or together with `namespaces`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Groups can be imported using the name of the group
terraform import cosmo_organization_group.example platform-team
# or alternatively, the UUID of the group
terraform import cosmo_organization_group.example 0b1b1b1b-1b1b-1b1b-1b1b-1b1b1b1b1b1b
```
